description: This Java source file defines the 'HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm' class, which implements an algorithm for performing placeholder substitution within strings based on DittoHeaders. It provides methods to create instances with specific placeholder definitions and to substitute placeholders in input strings with values resolved from DittoHeaders.

classes.name: HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm
classes.description: An immutable class that manages placeholder substitution logic based on DittoHeaders, allowing instantiation with custom replacement definitions and performing substitutions within strings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm with specified replacement definitions.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Performs placeholder substitution on an input string using DittoHeaders provided directly or via WithDittoHeaders, replacing placeholders with resolved values.
